name: Unsplash API
description: Keyword photo search; returns hotlinked CDN photo URLs.

restrictions: API guidelines: must hotlink the photo URLs returned by the API (no re-hosting)
Must credit photographer and Unsplash with UTM links
Must call the download-tracking endpoint when a photo is used
Demo apps limited to 50 req/h; production up to 5000 req/h after approval
license.notes: Photo licence is Unsplash's own; guidelines read from help.unsplash.com via search, full text not retrieved: re-verify before shipping.

cost.notes: Free API key required; hotlink + attribution + tracking.

verdictReason: Hotlinking and attribution rules conflict with the generate-once-and-store strategy; needs a proxy, never a client key.
